author: CreativeWorkzStudio LLC / ProfessorSeanEX
description: Diegetic key items and relics for Tenebris and Lux

items.name: Grandma's Watch
items.description: A cherished family heirloom keeping monotonic time across seconds, minutes, hours, weekdays, weeks, months, and years. Evolves into the Dream Compass.

items.name: Book of Monsters
items.description: An in-universe tactical compendium recording enemy threat HP, poise thresholds, movement budgets, and elemental vulnerabilities.

items.name: Book of Items
items.description: A comprehensive registry cataloging the properties of Sacyran herbs, tools, catalysts, and armaments.

items.name: Compass of Morality
items.description: A needle that wavers with the intent of the heart, diegetically reporting party moral sway along the continuum from -100 to +100.

items.name: The Dream Compass
items.description: The evolved form of Grandma's Watch. Detects and resonates with astral rifts, opening gates to the Dreamscape during active nocturnal windows (20:00 to 04:00).

items.name: Accord of Kings Parchment
items.description: The ancient treaty binding Sacyra and the Coalition. Inscribed with the sovereign principle: Joint Realm, Separate Kingdoms.
